capabilities: Read PDF, EPUB, and MOBI books with text, area, lasso, handwriting, photo, and voice excerpts
Convert every excerpt into a knowledge card that links back to the exact page position
Drag cards onto an infinite canvas to build cross-book mind maps with bi-linked, mergeable cards
Review cards as flashcards with a built-in FSRS-style spaced repetition scheduler
Recognize text in scanned PDFs with OCR and clip web pages into the vault
extras: Desktop-only (relies on Node.js/Electron APIs). Not yet in the community plugin directory; install via BRAT or manually. Chinese-first documentation: an 18-chapter Chinese tutorial is in docs/使用教程.md. All data is stored locally and exportable as a .marginpkg archive; no telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to read and annotate e-books or to carry excerpts through one pipeline from highlighting to mind-mapping to spaced-repetition review.

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible endpoint (e.g. DeepSeek) for the AI assistant
Tavily, Bocha, or self-hosted SearXNG for web search
Google Translate, Baidu, Youdao, or DeepL for translation

summary: All-in-one study tool that reads PDF/EPUB/MOBI books, turns excerpts into knowledge cards, organizes them on mind maps, and reviews them with spaced repetition.
